The HWPX inventory report generation failed because modified paragraphs incorrectly retained their layout cache elements.
The test 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, modified paragraphs still contained the 'hp:linesegarray' element, which should have been removed to invalidate the layout cache. The verifier returned a reward of 0.00, indicating that while the file was generated, it failed to meet the structural requirements for modified HWPX content.
